tools.name: deck.info
tools.description: Inspect a presentation in the deck engine's workspace (.pptx, .deckcraft or outline text): its slides with titles, layouts and shape counts, sections and theme. Reads only. `path` is relative to that workspace, a private folder only the deck.* tools read and write; files elsewhere on the device are not in it, so name a file deck.new or an earlier conversion wrote there.

tools.name: deck.text
tools.description: Read a presentation in the deck engine's workspace as outline text: slide titles unindented, bullets tab-indented by level, and the slide count. Reads only. `path` is relative to that workspace (see deck.info).

tools.name: deck.render
tools.description: Render one slide (0-based `slide`, default 0) of a presentation in the deck engine's workspace to a PNG at `out` (a .png path), its longest edge `max_side` pixels (default 1024). Both paths are relative to that workspace (see deck.info); nothing is written outside it, and a file already at `out` is replaced.

tools.name: deck.new
tools.description: Write a new presentation into the deck engine's workspace from slide titles and flat bullet lists (1 to 200 slides, at most 64 bullets each). `out` ends in .pptx or .deckcraft and is relative to that workspace (see deck.info); nothing is written outside it, and a file already at `out` is replaced.

tools.name: deck.convert
tools.description: Convert a presentation in the deck engine's workspace and write it there, in the format the extension of `out` names: .pptx, .deckcraft, outline .txt or .pdf. Both paths are relative to that workspace (see deck.info); nothing is written outside it, and a file already at `out` is replaced.
